shell.promoDescription: Grow your language skills with Trellis LMS.
shell.studioPromoDescription: Build, organise, and publish learning experiences with Trellis LMS.

units.savedAgo: Last saved {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} ago

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Continue your language journey. Build skills, track progress, and reach your goals with Trellis.

catalog.title: Course Catalog
catalog.description: Discover English and Chinese courses for every goal, from everyday communication to academic success.
catalog.searchPlaceholder: Search courses (for example: business English, HSK, speaking)
catalog.emptyDescription: Clear a filter or search for another topic.

player.videoPlaceholder: The lesson video plays here in the real app.
player.overviewBody: This lesson introduces the course, how it is structured, and what you will be able to do by the end of it.
player.qnaEmptyDescription: Ask the instructor about anything in this lesson.

studio.comingSoonDescription: Only the Content tab is built out in this prototype.

home.title: My Courses
home.description: Courses you own, newest change first.
home.versions: {count, plural, =0 {No published version} one {# version} other {# versions}}
home.learners: {count, plural, =0 {No learners} one {# learner} other {# learners}}
home.emptyTitle: You have not created a course yet
home.emptyDescription: Start a draft; nothing is visible to learners until you publish it.

draft.title: New course
draft.description: A draft is private. Choose a level framework now, because the two scales do not convert into each other.
draft.titlePlaceholder: For example: Chinese II — Daily Life
draft.frameworkNote: CEFR and the Chinese curriculum are separate scales. A course declares one, and levels never map across.
draft.summaryPlaceholder: One or two sentences a learner reads before enrolling.
draft.levelRequired: Choose a level on the selected framework.

detailsTab.title: Course details
detailsTab.lockedNote: A published version is a snapshot learners are already on. Change these on a new version instead.

settingsTab.title: Settings
settingsTab.note: Settings apply to the draft. Publishing copies them into the new version.

preflight.title: Publish
preflight.description: Everything below has to pass before a version can be cut.
preflight.blockedDescription: {count, plural, one {# check needs attention} other {# checks need attention}} before this course can go out.
preflight.pendingNote: A check that is still running blocks publishing too: an unscanned file cannot be served.

checks.assessmentsPublished: Assessments used by this course are published

questionBank.title: Question bank
questionBank.description: Questions are versioned. Once an assessment cites a revision, that revision stops changing.
questionBank.frozenNote: Used by {assessments}. Editing would change what graded attempts were marked against, so this makes a new revision instead.
questionBank.notUsed: Not used by any assessment yet
questionBank.emptyDescription: Clear the search, or add the first question.

assessmentAuthor.title: Assessment
assessmentAuthor.description: Pick question revisions, set the policy, then publish. Publishing freezes everything it cites.
assessmentAuthor.emptySelectionDescription: Add a question revision from the bank on the right.
assessmentAuthor.summary: {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} · {points} points
assessmentAuthor.unversionedNote: Publishing stamps a revision on this policy, so a grade can always name the rules it was produced under.

assessment.instructions: Read each question carefully and choose one answer. Your answers are saved as you go.
assessment.selectHint: Select the best answer. You can change your choice before submitting.
assessment.navigatorDescription: Jump to any question and review your answers before submitting.
assessment.footerNote: Designed for focused learning. Answers are saved only in this local prototype.

revealPolicies.afterFinalize: Answers shown after your attempt is graded
revealPolicies.afterClose: Answers shown after the assessment closes

lock.passScore: Score at least {score}% on “{lesson}” to open this lesson.
lock.title: This lesson is not open yet

landing.title: Course
landing.outlineNote: Lesson titles are public; the lessons themselves open once you enrol.
landing.alreadyEnrolled: You are enrolled in this course.
landing.noOpenEditionTitle: No edition is open right now
landing.noOpenEditionDescription: This course runs in cohorts. Check back when the next edition opens.
landing.moreLessons: {count, plural, one {# more lesson} other {# more lessons}}
landing.instructorStats: {courses, plural, one {# course} other {# courses}} • {learners} learners
landing.faqCertificateAnswer: Yes. Finish every lesson and pass the final assessment, and you can download a certificate of completion.
landing.faqAccessQuestion: How long do I have access?
landing.faqAccessAnswer: For as long as the edition you enrolled in runs. Your enrolment stays on that version even when the course is updated later.
landing.faqLevelAnswer: Check the requirements above. Anything not listed there is taught in the course.

enrol.title: Enrol in {course}
enrol.description: You will join {edition} and stay on course version {version} even after a newer one is published.
enrol.created: You are enrolled. The first lesson is ready.
enrol.alreadyEnrolled: You were already enrolled — this did not create a second enrolment.
enrol.editionClosed: This edition is closed. Pick another edition.
enrol.policyNote: Enrolment is free for this edition; payment is out of scope for now.

myCourses.title: My Courses
myCourses.description: Everything you are enrolled in, newest activity first.
myCourses.emptyTitle: You are not enrolled in anything yet
myCourses.emptyDescription: Browse the catalog and join a course to see it here.

attemptStart.title: Before you start
attemptStart.serverTimeNote: The clock runs on the server. Closing the tab does not pause it.
attemptStart.historyEmpty: You have not attempted this yet.
attemptStart.resumeNote: You have an attempt in progress. Starting again continues that one instead of creating a new attempt.
attemptStart.noAttemptsLeftDescription: You have used all {total} attempts. Ask your instructor if you need another.
attemptStart.expiredDescription: It ran past the time limit and was not submitted, so it does not count towards your grade.
attemptStart.proposedNote: These rules follow the proposed defaults and are not approved yet.

result.title: Result
result.gradingDescription: Marking is still running. The score appears here when it finishes.
result.revisionNote: Both are frozen, so re-running the grade gives the same result.
result.feedbackHidden: Feedback opens once every attempt is finalised.
result.pendingNote: An instructor marks this answer by hand.
result.adjustmentsNote: Adjustments are added, never edited, so the original mark stays on record.
result.historyNote: Your grade uses the {rule}, so it does not always follow the latest attempt.
result.duplicateSubmitNote: You submitted this attempt twice. The second submission returned the grade that already existed.

submitConfirm.title: Submit this attempt?
submitConfirm.description: You have answered {answered} of {total} questions. Submitting ends the attempt and starts grading.

complete.blocked: Open the lesson before marking it complete.
complete.note: Completion is recorded on the server; your progress may take a moment to catch up.

asOf.label: Figures as of {time}
asOf.note: Progress is rebuilt in the background, so it can trail a few minutes behind what you just did.

progressPage.title: Progress
progressPage.description: Where you are across every course you are enrolled in.
progressPage.gradeNote: Grades come from the assessment record, not from this summary.
progressPage.emptyDescription: Enrol in a course and your progress appears here.

achievementsPage.title: Achievements
achievementsPage.description: What you have earned, and what is next.

messagesPage.title: Messages
messagesPage.description: Conversations with your instructors and with support.
messagesPage.pickThreadDescription: Choose a conversation on the left to read it.
messagesPage.readOnlyNote: Replying is not wired up in this prototype.

notesPage.title: Notes
notesPage.description: Everything you wrote while studying, newest first.
notesPage.emptyTitle: You have not written a note yet
notesPage.emptyDescription: Notes you take inside a lesson collect here.

bookmarksPage.title: Bookmarks
bookmarksPage.description: Words, patterns and lessons you saved for later.
bookmarksPage.sourceGone: The lesson this came from is no longer published.
bookmarksPage.emptyDescription: Use the bookmark control inside a lesson to save it here.

studyPlanPage.title: Study Plan
studyPlanPage.description: A week at a time. Short sessions beat long ones you skip.
studyPlanPage.emptyDescription: Add a session to start a week.

searchPage.title: Search
searchPage.resultCount: {count, plural, one {# result} other {# results}} for “{query}”
searchPage.metadataOnly: You are not enrolled, so only the title is shown.
searchPage.emptyDescription: Try fewer words, or search for a course name.
searchPage.authorityNote: The index can trail a publish by a moment; the course itself is the authority.

studentsPage.title: Students
studentsPage.description: Everyone enrolled in a course you teach.
studentsPage.atRiskNote: Flagged by a rule for you to look at. It is not a decision about the learner.
studentsPage.emptyDescription: Learners appear here once they enrol.

gradingPage.title: Grading
gradingPage.description: Answers a person has to mark.
gradingPage.waitingCount: {count, plural, one {# answer waiting} other {# answers waiting}}
gradingPage.appendOnlyNote: A mark is added, never overwritten, so the original stays on record.
gradingPage.emptyDescription: Hand-marked answers land here when learners submit them.

analyticsPage.title: Analytics
analyticsPage.description: Where a cohort is strong, and where it is not.
analyticsPage.withheld: Hidden: the group is too small
analyticsPage.withheldNote: Below five learners a figure identifies people, so it is withheld.
analyticsPage.emptyDescription: Figures appear once a cohort has worked through the assessments.

assignmentsPage.title: Assignments
assignmentsPage.description: What you have set, and how much is in.
assignmentsPage.emptyDescription: Set an assignment from a course to see it here.

certificatesPage.title: Certificates
certificatesPage.description: Issued on completion. The serial is what a third party verifies.
certificatesPage.emptyDescription: A certificate is issued when a learner completes a course.

resourcesPage.title: Resources
resourcesPage.description: Files you uploaded. Nothing is served to learners until it has been scanned.
resourcesPage.pendingNote: A file still being scanned cannot be attached to a lesson yet.
resourcesPage.emptyDescription: Upload a file to attach it to a lesson.
